about_the_game:
This is a digitally remastered version of the Outsider soundtrack containing 19 complete songs. All songs in the package are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 and can be freely shared and used in your projects, including commercial ones, as long as the CC-BY 4.0 terms are respected.

Sixteen songs were created by the musicians Stellardrone and Malds, both unaffiliated with Galantrix or Outsider, and may be available on their personal pages in their original, non-remastered versions. The remaining three songs were made exclusively for the game by Aesthetic Indifference, including a rendition of Ave Maria composed by J.S. Bach and Charles Gounod.

Buying this Soundtrack is a great way to support the game and Creative Commons. Thank you!
